description: Hidden Patterns helps you understand recurring situations, behaviors, choices, and outcomes. Describe something that keeps happening in your work, routines, relationships, goals, or decision-making. Hidden Patterns asks focused follow-up questions to identify the pattern, what may be shaping it, what you may be overlooking, and a practical next step to try. Use it when a situation, behavior, decision, or outcome keeps repeating and you want to understand why. Its insights are reflective hypotheses, not medical or mental health diagnoses.

defaultPrompt: I know what I need to do, but I keep putting it off. What’s holding me back?
Why do I keep avoiding things I’m afraid I won’t be good at?
Why do I keep delaying my dreams until I feel ready?
